faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about how BitTasker works for both taskers and taskees.

0.question: What is BitTasker?
0.answer: BitTasker is a non-custodial, KYC-free marketplace built on Nostr. It covers Tasks, Services, Buy & Sell, and Temporary Staff. People pay with Bitcoin and USDT. RGB escrow is peer-to-peer: BitTasker does not take custody of the funds.

1.question: How does BitTasker work?
1.step_1_text: Describe what you need done and set a fair budget. Posting is free!
1.step_2_text: Receive offers from skilled Taskees. Compare their profiles, ratings, and reviews.
1.step_3_text: Choose a worker and lock Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning in escrow. The money stays there until you approve the work and pay their invoice.
1.step_4_text: Approve the work, pay the invoice, then leave a review. Reviews open only after that payment. Messages open only after escrow is formed.

0.question: How do I post a task?
0.answer: Simply create an account, click "Post a Task," and fill in the details. Provide a clear description, set a fair budget, and specify your timeline. The more details you provide, the better offers you'll receive from taskees.

1.question: How does payment work?
1.answer: When you accept a bid, you lock the agreed amount in escrow. Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, and Lightning all work. After the worker submits the work and you approve it, you pay their invoice. Nothing is paid if you wait.

2.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the work?
2.answer: Do not pay the invoice. While the contract is still open and unpaid, either side can cancel it. There is no outside judge and no automatic refund.

3.question: Can I cancel a task?
3.answer: You can cancel while the contract is still open and has not been paid. Cancelling does not by itself send a refund. Once you have paid the invoice, that payment is final.

4.question: What are the fees for taskers?
4.answer: BitTasker charges the same fee for every asset, including Bitcoin and USDT. Each side pays 2.5%, 2.0%, or 1.5% based on tasks in the past 30 days. A repeat partnership is 1% per side. The same rates apply to Buy & Sell and Temporary Staff. See our Tasker Fees page for full details.

0.question: How do I find tasks?
0.answer: Browse available tasks in your area and skill set. You can filter by category, location, budget, and deadline. When you find a task that matches your skills, submit a competitive bid with your proposed approach and timeline.

1.question: How do I get paid?
1.answer: When the hirer accepts your bid, they lock the amount in escrow. You submit the work. After they approve it, you request payment and they pay that invoice. You are not paid on a timer.

2.question: What if the tasker doesn't approve my work?
2.answer: If the hirer does not approve, they should not pay the invoice. Either side can cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid. There is no automatic payout.

3.question: What are the fees for taskees?
3.answer: BitTasker charges the same fee for every asset, including Bitcoin and USDT. Each side pays 2.5%, 2.0%, or 1.5% based on tasks in the past 30 days. A repeat partnership is 1% per side. The same rates apply to Buy & Sell and Temporary Staff. See our Taskee Fees page for full details.

4.question: Do I need to own Bitcoin?
4.answer: You do not need bitcoin before you sign up. The hirer can pay in Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or Lightning. You can also buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer. That purchase is paid to your own address.

0.question: Why use Bitcoin?
0.answer: Bitcoin and USDT on RGB let you get paid without a bank in the middle. This wallet also pays and receives bitcoin over Lightning.

1.question: What are the fees?
1.answer_1: BitTasker charges the same service fee for every asset, including Bitcoin and USDT. Each side pays 2.5%, 2.0%, or 1.5% based on activity in the past 30 days. A repeat partnership is 1% per side. The same rates apply to Buy & Sell and Temporary Staff. The fee is shown when you make an offer.
1.answer_2: Sending Bitcoin or USDT can add a network fee. Lightning fees are usually tiny. BitTasker does not keep those fees. There is no swap inside the app.

0.question: What is Nostr?
0.answer: Nostr is an open, censorship-resistant social and messaging protocol. Instead of accounts on a company server, you use a public key (npub) as your identity and sign your messages with your private key (nsec). Your data can be relayed through many servers (relays), so no single party controls your account or content.

1.question: How do I own my data with Nostr?
1.answer: With Nostr, your identity is your key pair. You sign your posts and messages client-side, and they propagate through independent relays. You can change relays or use several at once without losing access to your identity or contacts, because your npub stays the same. This portability means you—not a platform—own your data and social graph.

2.question: How is Nostr secured?
2.answer: Security comes from public‑key cryptography. Your npub is a public identifier; your nsec is kept secret and used to sign events. Anyone can verify a message was created by you without learning your private key. Because relays don’t need to be trusted, the protocol remains resilient even if individual relays go offline or censor content.

3.question: How do you protect my Nostr private key (nsec)?
3.answer: Your Nostr key stays on this device. It is unlocked with your passkey when a signature is needed. BitTasker does not keep a copy, and there is no browser extension to install.

0.question: Is my payment secure?
0.answer: Yes. The hirer locks Bitcoin, USDT on RGB, or a Lightning payment in escrow. BitTasker cannot spend it. The hirer pays the worker's invoice only after approving the work.

1.question: What happens if something goes wrong?
1.answer: Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid, and sort it out in messages after escrow is formed (or in the bid before that). There is no automatic refund and no outside judge.
